turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
Questions with did are about the past, so first we need past action words. You know time words like yesterday: they tell us the action is finished.
Let me solve one: "Yesterday I (clean) my room." The action is finished, so I add -ed: Yesterday I cleaned my room.
Rule: for most action words, add -ed to show a finished past action.
Right: We cooked fish last night.
Wrong: We cook fish last night.
Now you. Write the past form: The cat (jump) onto the sofa.
